'''Raith Bannik''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Thief/Legends|thief]] who lived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. He tasked a Republic spacer to rescue his loved ones from the offworld [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] who have kidnapped them. To the dismay of the spacer and his friend [[Tonn]], Bannik's "loved ones" were just a bunch of toy [[Droid/Legends|droids]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Raith Bannik is a non-player character in the [[2011]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' [[Star Wars video games|video game]]. Republic players can interact with him to receive the "Penalty for Theft" mission.<ref name="TOR" />

===Gameplay alternatives===
The player can give Bannik back his "loved ones" and earn light side points, or smash them in front of his face, earning dark side points.
